三件事

2026.07.07

Life

你处在低谷期的时候

When you’re down in the dumps

只需要在乎三件事情

Only need to care about three things

你自己，你的钱，你内心的平静

Yourself, your money, and your inner peace

生命周期性的暗潮只是暂时的

The cyclic undercurrent of life is just temporary

你正在死去

You are dying

但也将迎来重生

But also bring about rebirth

— Ray Chan
